title: Localized tensor comparison on the free generators
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a universe u, A and B commutative R-algebras, and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B. Use the derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let Q be a cochain complex of A-modules, N a cochain complex of C-modules, F termwise scalar extension along A to E to C, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Assume Q is K-flat over A. Let m be a base-derived tensor cohomology model for Q and suppose m.localizedComparison_i followed by H^i(t) is an isomorphism for every integer i. The predicate P of [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property] holds for every shift of the free rank-one A-module in D(A), represented in Lean by ULift A. No flatness of C over E is required for this generator assertion.

proof.text: Apply the unshifted-unit comparison lemma to hQ, m and the all-degree hypothesis h. For each integer n apply shift stability of the predicate to this derived unit object and its property. This is the two-step Lean proof in localizedTensorComparisonProperty_generators.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_generators
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (h : ∀ i : ℤ, IsIso (m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t i)) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{0} A)))⟦n⟧)
